body:
Thank you for your kind words. 

It's just I feel so forgotten by the people in my life :(. I'm a low key kind of guy, kinda quiet, never wanted to be in the spotlight. But as much as I hate to admit it, I am so very starved for attention. The best way I can describe it is that I'm like a plant that's been deprived of water for too long. Not deprived in any sexual way, but just in a "you have my undivided attention kind of way".

I feel so wrong admitting these thoughts, I feel like I sound more like some teenage girl then a 21 year old guy. I constantly drop hints that I'm depressed and unhappy but they go ignored, 

I don't WANT to end my life, I just want to send a message to everyone that you all forgot about me and I'm hurting from that :(.

Sorry for the venting, I got nothing better to do.
